# Monsters

[API index](../index.md)

```typescript
function Monsters(range?: number | null, rarity?: MonsterRarity | number | null): EntityList;
```

Find alive, hostile, non-hidden monsters within the grid radius, filtered by rarity.
The default radius is 200 grid units. The result uses the same contract as World.Entities.Monsters.

**@keywords**

monsters, enemies, radius, rarity, reagent
